verdict.rationale: Framer is a visual design and website-building canvas, so professional vector tooling is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions a pen tool, path editing, boolean operations, or precise alignment controls. The closest material is general canvas refinement of layouts, spacing and typography (framer-docs-42), which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for vector editing.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work
